errors.unavailable: That sign-in provider is not available right now. Use your email and password.
errors.denied: The sign-in was cancelled. Nothing has changed.
errors.expired: That sign-in took too long. Start again.
errors.emailUnavailable: That provider shared no email address, so there is no account to sign in to.
errors.emailUnverified: That provider has not verified your email address, so we cannot sign you in.
errors.failed: That sign-in could not be completed. Try again.

passkey.failed: That passkey sign-in did not complete. Try again, or use your password.

validation.passwordTooShort: Passwords must be at least {{count}} characters.

settings.title: Settings

profile.timeZoneHelp: Dates and times are shown in this zone.
profile.localeHelp: The language this application speaks to you in.

profile.avatarTooLarge: That image is larger than 5 MB. Choose a smaller one.

password.title: Password

email.title: Email address
